sops.Title: NIH NTRR account and data access request (SOP-01)

steps.Title: S1
steps.Actor: Bureau/Office Chief (or Designee or employee's manager)
steps.Action: Requests a purchase card for the employee and nominates the cardholder and AO
steps.StepInput: Employee's need for a purchase card
steps.SourceQuote: The FCC issues Purchase Cards only to FCC Full-Time Employees(FTEs) upon request

steps.Title: S2
steps.Action: Completes the GSA purchase card web-based training
steps.SourceQuote: must complete the General Services Administration (GSA) purchase card web-based training prior to issuance of the purchase card

steps.Title: S3
steps.Action: Completes and signs Form A-498, certifying that the directive has been read and understood
steps.SourceQuote: Purchase card nominees and AO nominees shall certify on Form A-498 that they have read and understand the policies

steps.Title: S4
steps.Action: Signs the cardholder nominee's Form A-498
steps.SourceQuote: signed by their Bureau/Office Chief (or Assistant Bureau Chief (ABC) for Management if applicable) and their AO

steps.Title: S5
steps.Action: Signs the cardholder nominee's Form A-498
steps.SourceQuote: signed by their Bureau/Office Chief (or Assistant Bureau Chief (ABC) for Management if applicable) and their AO

steps.Title: S6
steps.Action: Submits the AO's training certificate of completion to the APC
steps.StepOutput: AO training certificate on file with the APC
steps.SourceQuote: Submit a certificate of completion of cardholder training (the same training required of purchase cardholder nominees) to the APC

steps.Title: S7
steps.Action: Submits the bank card application form, training certificate and signed Form A-498 to FOC RDG/TOG
steps.StepInput: Bank card application form, training certificate, signed Form A-498
steps.SourceQuote: submit a completed bank card application form to FOC, RDG/TOG for submission to the contractor bank

steps.Title: S8
steps.Action: Submits the bank card application to the contractor bank
steps.SourceQuote: for submission to the contractor bank

steps.Title: S9
steps.Action: Determines the monthly credit limit for an EAC contracting officer whose single transaction limit (set no higher than warrant authority) exceeds the MPT
steps.StepInput: Contracting officer's warrant authority and single transaction limit
steps.SourceQuote: will be granted a monthly credit limit at an amount determined by their AO to reasonably accommodate their higher single transaction limit

steps.Title: S10
steps.Action: Issues the card and opens the account with the default $15,000 single transaction and monthly limits, or the approved higher limits
steps.StepInput: Approved application, training certificate, Form A-498
steps.StepOutput: Issued purchase card and open account
steps.SourceQuote: issues and destroys cards; opens and closes accounts

steps.Title: S11
steps.Action: Submits a written request and justification of the cardholder's demonstrated need to the APC
steps.SourceQuote: upon written request and justification provided by the respective cardholder

steps.Title: S12
steps.Action: Reviews the request case by case
steps.SourceQuote: may be granted a single transaction limit up to the MPT on a case-by-case basis

steps.Title: S13
steps.Action: Permanently increases the cardholder's single transaction limit up to the MPT
steps.SourceQuote: may grant a permanent increase of the single transaction limit up to the MPT

steps.Title: S14
steps.Action: Submits FCC Form A-1204 Request for Monthly Credit Limit Increase to the APC
steps.StepInput: Cardholder need for a higher monthly limit
steps.SourceQuote: Submit a written request via FCC Form A-1204 Request for Monthly Credit Limit Increase to the APC

steps.Title: S15
steps.Action: Increases the cardholder's monthly credit limit on a temporary or permanent basis
steps.SourceQuote: monthly credit limit may be increased by the APC upon written request

steps.Title: S16
steps.Action: Retains the circumstances for the increase and its duration
steps.SourceQuote: shall be retained by the APC

steps.Title: S17
steps.Action: Reviews permanent monthly credit limit increases to determine whether the higher limits are still required
steps.SourceQuote: Permanent monthly credit limit increases shall be reviewed by the APC on a periodic basis

steps.Title: S18
steps.Action: Requests written authorization from the AO for the purchase
steps.SourceQuote: Obtain written authorization from the AO for each purchase before making the purchase

steps.Title: S19
steps.Action: Provides written authorization for the transaction to the cardholder
steps.SourceQuote: Provide written authorization (such as through a memo, note, or e-mail) to the cardholder for each purchase card transaction before the purchase is made

steps.Title: S20
steps.Action: Ensures funds are available for the purchase
steps.SourceQuote: Ensure availability of funds prior to initiating a purchase with the card

steps.Title: S21
steps.Action: Considers mandatory Government priority sources under FAR Part 8 before other sources and selects a merchant, directing questions to EAC
steps.SourceQuote: Other sources may be considered for use only after the priority sources have been considered

steps.Title: S22
steps.Action: Completes and attaches the Section 508 Determination and Findings for Purchase Requests Form
steps.StepInput: IT product or service covered by accessibility regulations
steps.SystemUsed: Section 508 Determination and Findings for Purchase Requests Form
steps.SourceQuote: Complete and attach Section 508 Determination and Findings for Purchase Requests Form if the item is covered by the accessibility regulations

steps.Title: S23
steps.Action: Considers the price of the goods or services and checks it against the single transaction limit
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders must consider the price of goods or services being purchased

steps.Title: S24
steps.Action: Reviews the vendor's terms and conditions for prohibited provisions
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders are responsible for reviewing terms and conditions applicable to any purchase before making the purchase

steps.Title: S25
steps.Action: Refers the agreement with prohibited provisions (or an indemnification clause) to EAC before making any commitment
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders shall refer all agreements that include such provisions to the Enterprise Acquisition Center (EAC) prior to making any commitment on behalf of the Government

steps.Title: S26
steps.Action: Establishes a contract that addresses the objectionable terms, consulting OGC as necessary
steps.SourceQuote: so that EAC can establish a contract that addresses the objectionable terms

steps.Title: S27
steps.Action: Makes the purchase with the card and ensures the state sales tax exemption is applied at the point of sale
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders should ensure that their purchases have been exempted from state sales tax at the point of sale

steps.Title: S28
steps.Action: Declines the purchase and seeks a merchant who will honor the tax exemption
steps.SourceQuote: the cardholder shall not make the purchase and should instead seek a merchant who will honor the exemption

steps.Title: S29
steps.Action: Validates receipt of the purchased items and signs the receipt or invoice received with the shipment
steps.SourceQuote: Validate the receipt of items purchased, as applicable

steps.Title: S30
steps.Action: Contacts the merchant to seek a credit for the charged sales tax and documents the effort
steps.StepOutput: Credit request and documentation of efforts
steps.SourceQuote: cardholders are responsible for contacting the merchant to seek a credit for the charged sales tax

steps.Title: S31
steps.Action: Issues the monthly SOA to the cardholder
steps.SourceQuote: monthly SOA received from the contractor bank

steps.Title: S32
steps.Action: Obtains the signature and date of the employee who accepted or first used the goods or services on the invoice
steps.StepOutput: Invoice signed and dated by the accepting employee
steps.SourceQuote: the cardholder may not reconcile his/her SOA until they have obtained the signature and date of that other employee on the invoice

steps.Title: S33
steps.Action: Reconciles the SOA against receipts, invoices and supporting documentation
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders shall reconcile their monthly SOA received from the contractor bank within seven (7) workdays after the end of the billing cycle

steps.Title: S34
steps.Action: Notes exceptions to the Certification Clause on the SOA and initials and dates the remarks
steps.SourceQuote: Any exceptions to the Certification Clause must be noted on the SOA by the cardholder or AO, with the remarks being initialed and dated

steps.Title: S35
steps.Action: Signs, dates and prints name on the reconciled SOA and forwards it to the AO
steps.StepOutput: Cardholder-certified SOA sent to the AO
steps.SourceQuote: the cardholder must affix a dated signature and printed name on the reconciled SOA and forward it to his/her AO for review

steps.Title: S36
steps.Action: Reviews the reconciled SOA to verify that all transactions were legal, proper, correct and necessary
steps.SourceQuote: AOs shall review each reconciled SOA received from their purchase cardholders within ten (10) workdays after the end of the billing cycle

steps.Title: S37
steps.Action: Notes exceptions to the Certification Clause on the SOA and initials and dates the remarks
steps.SourceQuote: Any exceptions to the Certification Clause must be noted on the SOA by the cardholder or AO, with the remarks being initialed and dated

steps.Title: S38
steps.Action: Signs, dates and prints name on the reconciled SOA and forwards it to FOC RDG/TOG
steps.SourceQuote: The AO then must forward the reconciled SOA to Financial Operations Center (FOC), Revenue and Disbursement Group (RDG)/Travel and Operations Group (TOG)

steps.Title: S39
steps.Action: Ensures the reconciled transaction data is entered into the core financial accounting system and charges are distributed to the correct accounts
steps.SourceQuote: ensuring all reconciled purchase card transaction data is entered into the Commission

steps.Title: S40
steps.Action: Pays the purchase card contractor bank
steps.SourceQuote: for paying the purchase card contractor bank

steps.Title: S41
steps.Action: Retains copies of the reconciled SOA and all supporting documentation for six years
steps.SourceQuote: Retain copies of each reconciled SOA, as well as all supporting documentation for purchase transactions for a period of six (6) years after final payment

steps.Title: S42
steps.Action: Reviews the receipts for the questioned transaction
steps.SourceQuote: Review the receipts. For example, the transaction in question may have posted to the SOA with a different merchant name.

steps.Title: S43
steps.Action: Contacts the merchant to try to resolve the disputed charge and documents the actions taken
steps.SourceQuote: the cardholder shall contact the merchant in an attempt to resolve the disputed charge. Cardholders shall document the actions taken to resolve the issue.

steps.Title: S44
steps.Action: Initiates a dispute request with the purchase card contractor bank
steps.StepOutput: Dispute filed with the contractor bank
steps.SourceQuote: If unable to resolve the dispute with the merchant, the cardholder shall immediately proceed with a dispute request with the purchase card contractor bank.

steps.Title: S45
steps.Action: Tracks the dispute to completion
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders shall track disputes to completion.

steps.Title: S46
steps.Action: Reports the lost or stolen card to the purchase card contractor bank
steps.SourceQuote: The cardholder shall immediately report lost or stolen purchase cards to the purchase card contractor bank

steps.Title: S47
steps.Action: Notifies the AO and the APC of the lost or stolen card
steps.SourceQuote: and notify both the AO and the APC

steps.Title: S48
steps.Action: Completes the GSA web-based refresher training
steps.SourceQuote: as refresher training every three (3) years or as directed by the APC

steps.Title: S49
steps.Action: Provides certification of the refresher training to the APC
steps.StepOutput: Certificate on file with the APC
steps.SourceQuote: and to provide certification of training to the APC

steps.Title: S50
steps.Action: Reviews purchase card usage to identify accounts with no activity in the preceding three years
steps.SourceQuote: the APC will review purchase card usage to identify inactive accounts

steps.Title: S51
steps.Action: Provides the list of inactive accounts to each Bureau/Office
steps.SourceQuote: The APC will provide a list of inactive accounts to each Bureau/Office

steps.Title: S52
steps.Action: Confirms the continued need for each inactive account
steps.SourceQuote: the Bureau/Office must confirm the continued need for each inactive account

steps.Title: S53
steps.Action: Suspends the inactive account until confirmation is received
steps.SourceQuote: suspension until confirmation is received

steps.Title: S54
steps.Actor: Reviewer (APC, independent auditors, OIG, or other federal entity)
steps.Action: Selects the cardholder's transactions for periodic or random review and requests the supporting documentation
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders shall be subject to periodic and/or random reviews of their purchase card transactions and purchase practices by the APC

steps.Title: S55
steps.Action: Furnishes copies of the reconciled SOAs and all supporting documentation directly to the reviewer
steps.SourceQuote: cardholders are directly responsible for furnishing copies of their reconciled SOAs and all other supporting documentation

steps.Title: S56
steps.Action: Reviews the cardholder's standing in the program, which may result in temporary suspension or expulsion
steps.SourceQuote: will be subject to review by the APC. Such review may, among other appropriate actions, result in temporary suspension

steps.Title: S57
steps.Action: Temporarily suspends card privileges or revokes AO authority until compliance is observed
steps.StepOutput: Suspended privileges or revoked AO authority
steps.SourceQuote: may result in temporary suspension of card privileges or revocation of AO authority by the APC until compliance is observed

steps.Title: S58
steps.Action: Reports the abuse, misuse or non-compliance to the cardholder's AO or the AO's immediate supervisor
steps.StepOutput: Report to the AO or supervisor
steps.SourceQuote: will report purchase card abuse, misuse, and non-compliance

steps.Title: S59
steps.Action: Permanently closes the purchase card privileges or revokes AO authority
steps.StepInput: Repeated non-compliance, or misuse or fraud
steps.StepOutput: Permanently closed privileges or revoked authority
steps.SourceQuote: Repeated instances of abuse, misuse, or non-compliance will result in permanent closure of purchase card privileges or revocation of AO authority

steps.Title: S60
steps.Action: Reports the misuse or fraud to the immediate supervisor (or ABC), the Chief of HRM Labor Relations and Performance Management, and the OIG
steps.StepOutput: Referral to supervisor, HR and OIG
steps.SourceQuote: the Chief of Human Resources Management Labor Relations and Performance Management, and the OIG for investigation and appropriate actions

steps.Title: S61
steps.Action: Investigates the reported misuse or fraud
steps.SourceQuote: the OIG for investigation and appropriate actions

steps.Title: S62
steps.Action: Processes the proposed disciplinary or adverse action under the Basic Negotiated Agreement or the FCC Personnel Manual
steps.SourceQuote: these actions will follow the normal progression through Human Resources

steps.Title: S63
steps.Action: Completes refresher training when required by the APC before restoration
steps.SourceQuote: The APC may also require the cardholder or AO to complete refresher training before restoring card privileges or AO authority.

steps.Title: S64
steps.Action: Restores card privileges or AO authority once compliance is observed
steps.StepInput: Observed compliance and any required refresher training
steps.SourceQuote: before restoring card privileges or AO authority

steps.Title: S65
steps.Action: Notifies the APC of the reassignment or departure
steps.SourceQuote: Prior to reassignment to another FCC organization or upon leaving the agency, notify the APC

steps.Title: S66
steps.Action: Gives the APC prior written notice of the transfer or separation and directs cancellation of the card
steps.StepOutput: Written notice/cancellation direction to the APC
steps.SourceQuote: prior notice shall be given to the APC

steps.Title: S67
steps.Action: Provides all purchase card records and supporting documentation to the AO
steps.SourceQuote: provide all of their purchase card records and supporting documentation to their AO

steps.Title: S68
steps.Action: Surrenders the purchase card to the AO or the APC
steps.SourceQuote: surrender their purchase card to their AO or the APC

steps.Title: S69
steps.Action: Closes the cardholder's account
steps.StepOutput: Closed account and cancelled procurement authority
steps.SourceQuote: the APC shall close the cardholder's account

steps.Title: S70
steps.Action: Notes on the final reconciled SOA that the departed cardholder could not sign and date it
steps.SourceQuote: the AO shall note this on the cardholder's final reconciled SOA

steps.Title: S71
steps.Action: Designates a new AO to assume the duties of the previous AO
steps.SourceQuote: a new AO will be designated by the appropriate Bureau/Office Chief (or ABC if applicable)

steps.Title: S72
steps.Action: Sends the change in AO designation in writing to the APC
steps.SourceQuote: This change in official designation shall be sent in writing to the APC.

steps.Title: S1
steps.Action: Nominate the CH by email or memo and notify the A/OPC of the new participant
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will be nominated by the requesting department by email or memo.

steps.Title: S2
steps.Action: Complete the required initial training (DAU CLG0001, online DON GCPC for role, DoD ethics, CLG 006 for COs and D/AOs, activity IOP)
steps.SourceQuote: All GCPC program participants will complete initial training before assuming program responsibility.

steps.Title: S3
steps.Action: Provide copies of all training certificates to the A/OPC
steps.SourceQuote: A copy of all training certificates will be provided to the A/OPC.

steps.Title: S4
steps.Action: Acknowledge responsibility and understanding of reference (a) and this instruction
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will acknowledge the responsibility

steps.Title: S5
steps.Action: Appoint the CH by written delegation of authority setting single purchase, monthly CH and monthly office limits
steps.SourceQuote: These limits are established in each cardholder delegation of authority letter.

steps.Title: S6
steps.Action: Appoint the CH using SF 1402 Certificate of Appointment specifying spending limits and authorized transaction types
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will be appointed using SF 1402 (Certificate of Appointment)

steps.Title: S7
steps.Action: Coordinate the card application and issuance with CITIBANK
steps.SourceQuote: The A/OPC also coordinates card applications, issuance and destruction of cards

steps.Title: S8
steps.Action: Incorporate merchant category authorization codes into the card at issuance
steps.StepOutput: Issued card with merchant category codes
steps.SourceQuote: authorization codes are incorporated in the card by CCPMD

steps.Title: S9
steps.Action: Complete activity IOP and DON purchase card refresher training (CCPMD regional, DAU CLG0004, or online DON GCPC)
steps.SourceQuote: complete activity IOP and DON purchase card refresher training within two years

steps.Title: S10
steps.Action: Provide a copy of the training certificate to the A/OPC
steps.SourceQuote: A copy of all training certificates will be provided to the A/OPC.

steps.Title: S11
steps.Action: Suspend the participant's account until training is completed
steps.SourceQuote: Failure to complete training will result in suspension of account until training is completed.

steps.Title: S12
steps.Action: Prepare SF 182 for the employee: assign an LOA, state in Section C that payment will be made with the GCPC, and annotate the CH's name and phone, obtaining CH information from N4
steps.SourceQuote: Each division prepares the SF 182 for their employees. This includes assignment of a LOA.

steps.Title: S13
steps.Action: Obtain the appropriate signatures for approval on SF 182
steps.SourceQuote: obtain appropriate signatures for approval

steps.Title: S14
steps.Action: Provide a copy of SF 182 to N4
steps.SourceQuote: Provide a copy of SF 182 to N4 prior to forwarding to Human Resources Office.

steps.Title: S15
steps.Action: Forward SF 182 to the Human Resources Office
steps.SourceQuote: forwarding to Human Resources Office

steps.Title: S16
steps.Action: Provide signed copies to N8 and the CH so the purchase can be made
steps.StepOutput: CH authorized to pay for training
steps.SourceQuote: Signed copies are provided to N8 and the purchase card holder so the purchase can be made.

steps.Title: S17
steps.Action: Email the requirement to N8
steps.SourceQuote: Requests are emailed to N8.

steps.Title: S18
steps.Action: Forward an unusual or questionable request to the Deputy Comptroller, Comptroller and possibly Legal (N00D)
steps.SourceQuote: Unusual or questionable requests are forwarded to the Deputy Comptroller, Comptroller, and possibly Legal (N00D)

steps.Title: S19
steps.Action: Review the request before action is taken
steps.SourceQuote: for review prior to taking action

steps.Title: S20
steps.Action: Check whether funding is available
steps.SystemUsed: Corporate Master Execution File Funds Status System

steps.Title: S21
steps.Action: Assign the appropriate LOA to the routine request
steps.SourceQuote: routine requests are processed by assigning the appropriate LOA

steps.Title: S22
steps.Action: Provide the LOA and document number to the requestor and to the CH with a request to make the purchase
steps.SourceQuote: The LOA and document number are provided to the requestor, and to the purchase card holder with a request to make the purchase.

steps.Title: S23
steps.Action: Complete the required documentation (SF 182 or NETC 4235/4) and obtain approval signatures
steps.SourceQuote: the requestor completes the required documentation, obtains the appropriate signatures for approval

steps.Title: S24
steps.Action: Provide signed copies to N8 and the CH
steps.SourceQuote: provides signed copies to N8 and the purchase card holder so the purchase can be made

steps.Title: S25
steps.Action: Forward the requirement to the Comptroller for review when funding is exhausted
steps.SourceQuote: If funding is exhausted, requirements are forwarded to the Comptroller for review.

steps.Title: S26
steps.Action: Notify Division Directors/Special Assistants and ask for remaining unfunded requirements
steps.SourceQuote: N8 notifies the Division Directors/Special Assistants asking for remaining unfunded requirements

steps.Title: S27
steps.Action: Submit remaining unfunded requirements to N8

steps.Title: S28
steps.Action: Identify funding and notify departments
steps.SourceQuote: Once funding is identified, departments are notified.

steps.Title: S29
steps.Action: Make only the end-of-fiscal-year purchases approved by N8
steps.SourceQuote: Cardholders will only make end-of-fiscal-year purchases that have been approved by N8.

steps.Title: S30
steps.Action: Confirm that sufficient funds are committed by the R/FM
steps.SourceQuote: Ensure sufficient funds are committed by the R/FM.

steps.Title: S31
steps.Action: Screen the purchase request against mandatory supply sources (e.g., AbilityOne) and delegated authority
steps.SourceQuote: Screen the purchase request from mandatory supply sources (i.e., Ability One)

steps.Title: S32
steps.Action: Approve a purchase that exceeds the CH's single purchase limit
steps.SourceQuote: The single purchase limit cannot be exceeded unless approved by N4.

steps.Title: S33
steps.Action: Obtain AO approval before purchasing
steps.SourceQuote: Obtain AO approval prior to purchasing.

steps.Title: S34
steps.Action: Order office supplies from DoD EMALL or SERVMART using NETC 4400/1, or procure printing from DLA Document Services
steps.StepInput: AO-approved office supply or printing request
steps.SystemUsed: DoD EMALL / SERVMART; NETC 4400/1; DLA Document Services
steps.SourceQuote: procure office supplies from DoD EMALL or SERVMART using NETC 4400/1. Procure printing requirements from DLA Document Services.

steps.Title: S35
steps.Action: Determine whether the merchant's price is fair and reasonable, rotating orders among qualified contractors
steps.SourceQuote: Rotate orders among qualified contractors to the maximum extent practicable.

steps.Title: S36
steps.Action: Confirm the merchant agrees not to charge until shipped, not to back order, to deliver within 30 days, and to include the required packing-list information
steps.SourceQuote: The CH must confirm that the merchant agrees

steps.Title: S37
steps.Action: Remind the merchant not to charge sales tax and seek FOB destination shipping terms
steps.SourceQuote: Merchants should be reminded not to charge sales tax

steps.Title: S38
steps.Action: Place the order over the counter, by phone, or via the internet with account safeguards
steps.SourceQuote: CH may proceed to purchase the supplies

steps.Title: S39
steps.Action: Check single purchase, billing cycle, and office limits, transaction method, and merchant type before authorizing
steps.SourceQuote: the CITIBANK authorization system checks the CH's single purchase limit, the billing cycle purchase limit, the AO's billing cycle office limit

steps.Title: S40
steps.Action: Contact the A/OPC about the denied transaction
steps.SourceQuote: CHs must contact the A/OPC for denied transactions.

steps.Title: S41
steps.Action: Record the transaction in the purchase card log with documentation supporting the decision and any special approvals
steps.SourceQuote: A purchase card log, NETC 4430/1, is required to record all purchase card transactions.

steps.Title: S42
steps.Action: Receive and inspect the supplies or services, signing and dating
steps.SourceQuote: one will perform receipt/inspection

steps.Title: S43
steps.Action: Accept the supplies or services, signing and dating
steps.SourceQuote: one will accept. These actions must be accomplished by legible signature and date.

steps.Title: S44
steps.Action: Certify that the quality and quantity furnished match the agreement with the vendor
steps.SourceQuote: Certify that the quality and quantity of the items furnished are per this agreement (verbal or written) with the vendor.

steps.Title: S45
steps.Action: Identify whether the materials are accountable property (unit cost $5,000 or more, or sensitive, pilferable, or classified)
steps.SourceQuote: AOs and CHs identify whether materials need to be recorded in a formal property management or accounting system.

steps.Title: S46
steps.Action: Record accountable property in DPAS
steps.SourceQuote: All materials classified as accountable property will be recorded in the Defense Property Accounting System (DPAS). DPAS is maintained by N4.

steps.Title: S47
steps.Action: Issue the monthly statement at billing cycle end; status changes from INTERIM to NEW
steps.SourceQuote: within five business days when the statement status changes

steps.Title: S48
steps.Action: Verify the accuracy of each transaction against receipts and the log, and ensure each is charged or reallocated to the proper LOA
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will verify the accuracy of each transaction at the end of the monthly billing cycle.

steps.Title: S49
steps.Action: Use pay-and-confirm: confirm with the vendor that items are in transit, pay in full, and track the unreceived transactions
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will confirm with the vendor that the items ordered are in transit

steps.Title: S50
steps.Action: Retain the transaction documentation for damaged warranty items in a suspense file until the transaction or credit appears
steps.StepInput: Damaged item with contractor repair/replace commitment
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will retain the transaction documentation in a suspense file until the transaction or credit appears on the statement.

steps.Title: S51
steps.Action: Notify the A/OPC to resolve and reconcile the statement
steps.SourceQuote: the CH or AO will notify the A/OPC to resolve and reconcile the statement

steps.Title: S52
steps.Action: Attach an explanation for each undocumented transaction (item, cost, date, merchant, price, quantity, and why there is no documentation)
steps.SourceQuote: they must attach an explanation

steps.Title: S53
steps.Action: Certify the bank statement and forward all documentation to the AO/CO
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will certify the bank statement and forward all documentation to the AO/CO.

steps.Title: S54
steps.Action: Reconcile the CH's statement in CITIBANK, ensure purchases were appropriate and charges accurate, and verify supporting documentation
steps.SourceQuote: Reconcile the CH's monthly statement in CITIBANK.

steps.Title: S55
steps.Action: Ensure receipt, inspection and acceptance were done for all items, e.g., by initialing each receipt
steps.SourceQuote: Ensure proper receipt, acceptance, and inspection is accomplished on all items being certified for payment.

steps.Title: S56
steps.Action: Notify the A/OPC or NETC N4 of a suspected unauthorized purchase
steps.SourceQuote: Notify the A/OPC or NETC N4 in the event of any suspected unauthorized purchase

steps.Title: S57
steps.Action: Certify the monthly invoice and forward it for payment
steps.SourceQuote: Certify the monthly invoice within 10 business days

steps.Title: S58
steps.Action: Complete the monthly PAT review and return all supporting documentation to the CH
steps.StepOutput: Completed PAT review; documents returned to CH
steps.SourceQuote: Complete the monthly PAT Review within 15 calendar days of the end of the billing cycle and return all supporting documentation to the CH.

steps.Title: S59
steps.Action: Notify the AO that the CH is not available to review the statement
steps.SourceQuote: Notify the AO if CH is not available to review the statement for certification.

steps.Title: S60
steps.Action: Review the CH's statement and documentation and certify the account for payment
steps.SourceQuote: The AO will review the CH's statement and documentation and certify the account for payment.

steps.Title: S61
steps.Action: Meet with the CH upon their return to review the statement
steps.SourceQuote: The AO will meet with the CH upon their return to review the CH's statement.

steps.Title: S62
steps.Action: Contact the A/OPC about the suspect transaction
steps.SourceQuote: The CH or AO must contact the A/OPC to determine which procedure is appropriate

steps.Title: S63
steps.Action: Determine whether the dispute or the fraud procedure applies, so only one is initiated
steps.SourceQuote: initiate only one procedure for a suspect transaction

steps.Title: S64
steps.Action: Dispute the transaction through the invoice certification process in CitiDirect, not by calling CITIBANK
steps.SourceQuote: Transactions must be disputed through the invoice certification process within CitiDirect.

steps.Title: S65
steps.Action: Submit the signed CITIBANK Government Cardholder Dispute Form by fax or mail
steps.SystemUsed: Fax 605-357-2019 or mail; Appendix B form
steps.SourceQuote: submit/fax the CITIBANK Government Cardholder Dispute Form (Appendix B) to CITIBANK at 605-357-2019

steps.Title: S66
steps.Action: Track the dispute to resolution
steps.SourceQuote: Track the dispute to resolution either by calling CITIBANK or reviewing the CITIBANK dispute log within CitiDirect.

steps.Title: S67
steps.Action: Issue a vendor or bank credit (chargeback) and a rebill debit to offset the short pay
steps.SourceQuote: the charge is offset by either a vendor credit or bank initiated credit

steps.Title: S68
steps.Action: Send the CH a letter explaining the decision in favor of the merchant
steps.StepOutput: Decision letter; rebill on next invoice
steps.SourceQuote: a letter will be sent to the CH explaining the decision

steps.Title: S69
steps.Action: Certify the rebilled charge on the next invoice for payment
steps.SourceQuote: the charge will appear in the balance due on the next invoice and must be certified for payment

steps.Title: S70
steps.Action: Notify the A/OPC of suspected fraudulent activity
steps.SourceQuote: The CH must notify the A/OPC immediately of any suspected fraudulent activity on the account.

steps.Title: S71
steps.Action: Contact CITIBANK about the fraud
steps.SourceQuote: The A/OPC will contact CITIBANK.

steps.Title: S72
steps.Action: Close the compromised account, open a replacement account and issue a new card
steps.SourceQuote: Accounts reported with fraudulent activity will be closed immediately, and replacement accounts are opened and new cards issued.

steps.Title: S73
steps.Action: Confirm with the CH which transactions are valid and move valid transactions to the new account
steps.SourceQuote: The bank will confirm with the CH which transactions are valid and which are fraudulent

steps.Title: S74
steps.Action: Short-pay the invoice by the fraudulent amount and certify using the manual certification process, not the dispute process
steps.SourceQuote: certified using the manual certification process, not the dispute process

steps.Title: S75
steps.Action: Complete the Declaration of Unauthorized Use form and submit it to the bank
steps.SourceQuote: the CH will complete a Declaration of Unauthorized Use form (Appendix C) to be submitted to the bank

steps.Title: S76
steps.Action: Follow further guidance from the A/OPC
steps.SourceQuote: The CH will follow further guidance provided by the A/OPC.

steps.Title: S77
steps.Action: Call CITIBANK to report the lost or stolen card
steps.SourceQuote: the CH must immediately notify CITIBANK by calling 1-800-790-7206

steps.Title: S78
steps.Action: Notify the AO and the A/OPC of the lost or stolen card
steps.SourceQuote: The CH must also notify the AO and the A/OPC of a lost or stolen card within one business day

steps.Title: S79
steps.Action: Submit a written report to the A/OPC (last six card digits, CH name, date and location, police report date, bank notification time, same-day purchases, other information)
steps.SourceQuote: The AO will submit a written report to the A/OPC within one business day.

steps.Title: S80
steps.Action: Mail a replacement card
steps.SourceQuote: CITIBANK will mail a replacement card within one business day of the reported loss or theft.

steps.Title: S81
steps.Action: Cut the found card in half and give it to the AO or the A/OPC
steps.SourceQuote: will be cut in half and given to their AO or the A/OPC

steps.Title: S82
steps.Action: Ensure the CH account is inactive at least 30 days (one billing cycle) before departure
steps.SourceQuote: the A/OPC shall ensure, to the maximum extent possible, that the CH account is inactive at least 30 days

steps.Title: S83
steps.Action: Turn in all files documenting GCPC transactions to the AO/CO
steps.SourceQuote: All files documenting GCPC transactions shall be turned in to the AO/CO for retention when a CH leaves the command.

steps.Title: S84
steps.Action: Reduce the CH single and monthly limits to $1.00 and cut up the card
steps.SourceQuote: the A/OPC shall reduce the CH credit limits, as soon as practical, to $1.00 (single and monthly limits) and cut up the GCPC

steps.Title: S85
steps.Action: Close the account once all transactions and payments have cleared
steps.SourceQuote: The A/OPC will close the account once all transactions and payments have cleared.

steps.Title: S86
steps.Action: Retain the financial transaction records for audit
steps.SourceQuote: be retained for a period of 10 years

steps.Title: S87
steps.Action: Provide a copy of the conference approval request to N4 with the line of accounting specified
steps.SourceQuote: Departments desiring to sponsor a conference will provide a copy of the approval request to N4 ensuring that a line of accounting is specified.

steps.Title: S88
steps.Action: Provide a copy of the final bill to N4
steps.SourceQuote: Provide a copy of the final bill to N4 upon completion of the conference.

steps.Title: S89
steps.Action: Take appropriate action, including an investigation, and determine the corrective or disciplinary action based on the circumstances
steps.SourceQuote: shall take appropriate action, including an investigation

steps.Title: S90
steps.Action: Review transactions for internal controls, training, span of control and delinquencies; the review is automatically submitted to the next higher level A/OPC
steps.SourceQuote: The A/OPC shall conduct a review of transactions using the DON Data Mining System PAT

steps.Title: S91
steps.Action: Conduct the semi-annual review aggregating the previous six monthly reviews
steps.SystemUsed: DON Data Mining System PAT; Appendix D worksheet
steps.SourceQuote: The A/OPC shall conduct the semi-annual review using the approved DON Data Mining System PAT and the Semi-Annual Review Auxiliary Worksheet (Appendix D).

steps.Title: S92
steps.Action: Provide the report to the HA (N4) for review and approval
steps.SourceQuote: The report shall be provided to the HA (N4) for review and approval.

steps.Title: S93
steps.Action: Review and approve the semi-annual report
steps.SourceQuote: Upon approval

steps.Title: S94
steps.Action: Forward the approved report to the Hierarchy Level 3 A/OPC
steps.SourceQuote: the report will be forwarded to the Hierarchy Level 3 A/OPC

steps.Title: S95
steps.Action: Compile the report and submit it to CCPMD
steps.SourceQuote: for compilation and submission to CCPMD

steps.Title: S96
steps.Actor: PMR Team procurement analyst (NAVSUP FLC Norfolk)
steps.Action: Inform N4 of the review by formal letter
steps.SourceQuote: The analyst will inform N4 of the review by formal letter.

steps.Title: S97
steps.Action: Compile the required documents for HA review and approval
steps.SourceQuote: The A/OPC will compile the required documents for review and approval by the HA.

steps.Title: S98
steps.Action: Review and approve the review package
steps.SourceQuote: Upon HA approval

steps.Title: S99
steps.Action: Forward the approved package to the PMR Team by traceable means
steps.SourceQuote: the review will be forwarded by traceable means to the PMR Team by the required date

steps.Title: S100
steps.Action: Perform the desk audit of transactional, internal management, and program elements
steps.SourceQuote: will perform this 18 month desk audit

steps.Title: S101
steps.Action: Suspend all card accounts for three days except one CH and one AO account for mission-essential requirements
steps.SourceQuote: Failure to pass this review will result in a three-day suspension of all card accounts

steps.Title: S102
steps.Action: Provide mandatory stand-down training to all GCPC participants
steps.SourceQuote: mandatory stand-down training will be provided to all GCPC participants

steps.Title: S103
steps.Action: Develop corrective actions for discrepant areas and prepare a Plan of Action and Milestones
steps.SourceQuote: prepare a Plan of Action and Milestones

steps.Title: S1
steps.Action: Enter the Loan Action into the Computer Tracking System and/or Loan File
steps.StepInput: Borrower request for a Loan Action
steps.SystemUsed: Computer Tracking System and/or Loan File
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must enter all Loan Actions into their Computer Tracking System and/or Loan File.

steps.Title: S2
steps.Action: Check that a request to modify the terms and/or conditions of the 7(a) Loan has been submitted in writing
steps.SourceQuote: Ensure that the Servicing Request is in the Proper Format

steps.Title: S3
steps.Action: Submit the request to modify the Loan terms and/or conditions in writing, as the Lender requires
steps.StepInput: Lender requirement for a written request
steps.SourceQuote: to submit all requests to modify the terms and/or conditions of a 7(a) Loan, in writing

steps.Title: S4
steps.Action: Research the Loan Program Requirements that apply to the requested Loan Action
steps.SourceQuote: Research the Applicable Loan Program Requirements

steps.Title: S5
steps.Action: Apply the Loan Program Requirements of SOP 50 10 in effect at the time of the action, per 13 C.F.R. §120.180 (see Chapters 8 and 11)
steps.StepInput: Assumption or substitution of collateral or Obligors request
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must comply with the Loan Program Requirements of SOP 50 10 in effect at the time the action takes place

steps.Title: S6
steps.Action: Consult Chapters 7 through 12 of this SOP for guidance on developing the Servicing Request
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders may refer to Chapters 7 through 12 of this SOP for guidance

steps.Title: S7
steps.Action: Verify the request includes the needed Supporting Documents. Credit-analysis actions need the Borrower's current financial statement and two most recent years of federal tax returns. Collateral actions additionally need a current appraisal, a lien search (title report or UCC search), and evidence of senior lien balances.
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should ensure that all Servicing Requests include the Supporting Documents that a prudent lender would need to make an informed decision.

steps.Title: S8
steps.Action: Order a new credit report to verify the submitted financial information
steps.SourceQuote: Generally, Lenders should order a new credit report to verify the financial information submitted

steps.Title: S9
steps.Action:
Obtain the conditional additional Supporting Documents:
- current financial statements and two years of tax returns from all Obligors, when a complete repayment analysis is necessary
- executed sale or refinance documents, when the request involves sale or refinance of collateral
- an Environmental Investigation Report, when Chapter 5 Paragraph C requires one
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should obtain any additional Supporting Documentation needed to properly analyze and approve their Servicing Request.

steps.Title: S10
steps.Action: Obtain evidence (e.g., board resolution) that each required signer has authority to execute the Loan Documents
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should obtain and provide proper evidence to establish that each Person whose signature is necessary has the required authority

steps.Title: S11
steps.Action: Analyze the Borrower's financial statements to determine whether the Borrower can repay the Loan if the request is approved
steps.StepInput: Financial statements, tax returns, credit report
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must analyze the Borrower's financial statements to determine whether the Borrower is financially viable

steps.Title: S12
steps.Action: Deny the requested Loan Action and take more appropriate actions (see Chapter 15 on liquidation status)
steps.StepInput: Finding that the Borrower is not viable
steps.SourceQuote: If not, Lenders should deny the requested Loan Action and take more appropriate actions.

steps.Title: S13
steps.Action: Where the request will impact collateral, analyze the Recoverable Value of the collateral before and after the requested Loan Action
steps.StepInput: Appraisal, lien search, senior lien balances
steps.StepOutput: Before and after Recoverable Value analysis
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should conduct a thorough analysis of the Recoverable Value of the collateral before and after the requested Loan Action.

steps.Title: S14
steps.Action:
Review the existing Loan Documents and the Computer Tracking System for:
- consistency with the Borrower's previous representations
- non-monetary Defaults
- collateral deficiencies
- Loan Document problems
steps.StepInput: Existing Loan Documents and tracking records
steps.StepOutput: List of problems or Defaults found
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should review the existing Loan Documents and their Computer Tracking System

steps.Title: S15
steps.Action: Condition approval on the Borrower curing each identified Default (e.g., reinstating lapsed insurance, providing past due financial statements)
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should condition their approval of every Loan Action upon the Borrower curing any Default identified in Step 8 above.

steps.Title: S16
steps.Action:
Set the consideration the Borrower must provide to make the change legally binding, e.g.:
- fixing document errors
- waiving defenses
- releasing lender liability claims
- providing additional collateral
- providing updated financial information
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must ensure that Borrowers provide consideration (i.e., something of value)

steps.Title: S17
steps.Action: Obtain written consent from each Obligor to any material change in the Loan terms and conditions
steps.StepInput: List of Obligors and proposed changes
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must obtain the written consent to any material change in the terms and conditions of the Loan from each Obligor

steps.Title: S18
steps.Action: Justify and document the decision in a Loan Action Record that is independent of any document prepared by a senior lienholder or other conflicted Person
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must justify and document their decision in a Loan Action Record

steps.Title: S19
steps.Action: Give SBA notice of the Loan Action as required by SBA Loan Program Requirements (see Chapter 3)
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must comply with applicable SBA Loan Program Requirements pertaining to decision making authority and notice to SBA.

steps.Title: S20
steps.Action: File a copy of the Loan Action Record and Supporting Documents in the Loan File, and enter the substance of related calls and meetings
steps.StepInput: Loan Action Record, Supporting Documents, call and meeting notes
steps.SystemUsed: Loan File and/or Computer Tracking System
steps.SourceQuote: keep a copy of the Loan Action Record and Supporting Documents in the Lender’s Loan File

steps.Title: S21
steps.Action: Prepare an internal credit memo that is independent of any analysis by a conflicted Person and adequately analyzes the Supporting Documents
steps.StepInput: Loan Action Record and Supporting Documents
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should include a credit memo, which must be independent of any document or analysis prepared by a Person with a conflict of interest

steps.Title: S22
steps.Action:
Draft the Servicing Request letter or email based on the credit memo, covering the eight required elements:
1. description of the action
2. justification
3. loan funding, balance, and status
4. Obligor financial condition
5. mitigating factors and collateral analysis
6. prior servicing history
7. FTA consent status
8. Obligor list with consent statement
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders should submit all Servicing Requests that require prior written SBA approval in a clearly and concisely drafted letter or electronic mail submission

steps.Title: S23
steps.Action: Submit the Servicing Request to the LGPC in Citrus Heights, CA, or to the appropriate USEAC for EWCP Loans
steps.StepInput: Servicing Request letter or email and credit memo
steps.SourceQuote: Prior to final disbursement of a 7(a) Loan, Lenders should submit Servicing Requests to the LGPC in Citrus Heights, CA, or for EWCP Loans, the appropriate USEAC.

steps.Title: S24
steps.Action:
Submit the Servicing Request to the CLSC for:
- Loans in regular servicing
- SBA Express, Export Express, Community Advantage, and Pilot Program Loans in liquidation
Submit to the NGPC for all other Loans in liquidation.
steps.StepInput: Servicing Request letter or email and credit memo
steps.SourceQuote: After final disbursement, Lenders should submit Servicing Requests for all Loans in regular servicing status to the CLSC

steps.Title: S25
steps.Action: Review the Servicing Request, consulting the appropriate USEAC as needed (CLSC), and respond to the Lender
steps.SourceQuote: SBA will attempt to respond to a Lender's request for approval of a Servicing Request within 15 business days

steps.Title: S26
steps.Action: Enter SBA's response to the Servicing Request in the Computer Tracking System and/or Loan File
steps.SystemUsed: Computer Tracking System and/or Loan File
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must note and/or enter SBA’s response to all Servicing Requests in the Lender’s Computer Tracking System and/or Loan File

steps.Title: S27
steps.Action: File the Loan Action Record and Supporting Documents in the Loan File, and enter the substance of calls and meetings about the request
steps.StepInput: Loan Action Record, Supporting Documents, call and meeting notes
steps.SystemUsed: Loan File and/or Computer Tracking System
steps.SourceQuote: enter the substance of any telephone calls and/or face-to-face meetings regarding the Servicing Request in the Lender’s Loan File

steps.Title: S28
steps.Action: Modify each Loan Document impacted when the approved Loan Action changes the terms and conditions of the Note or another Loan Document
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must modify each impacted Loan Document

steps.Title: S29
steps.Action: Prepare any new Loan Document needed and ensure its proper execution
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must properly prepare and ensure proper execution of any new Loan Document

steps.Title: S30
steps.Action: Record the modified and new Loan Documents in the public record
steps.StepInput: Modified and executed new Loan Documents
steps.SourceQuote: Lenders must properly record modified Loan Documents, as well as any new Loan Documents, in the public record.

steps.Title: S1
steps.Action: Assess the adverse event's harm and when it was discovered relative to the episode of care
steps.StepInput: Adverse event during the patient's care

steps.Title: S2
steps.Action: Determine whether the harm is more than minor, using the test of whether it requires an incident report
steps.StepOutput: Harm classified as minor or more than minor
steps.SourceQuote: If a harm is significant enough to require an incident report or local equivalent, it should be considered more than minor.

steps.Title: S3
steps.Action: Take responsibility for performing the clinical disclosure
steps.StepInput: Harm classified as more than minor
steps.SourceQuote: must be performed by the responsible practitioner

steps.Title: S4
steps.Actor: Clinical team member (the responsible practitioner when harm is more than minor)
steps.Action: Provide preliminary factual information to the patient or personal representative, face-to-face in a private setting when practical
steps.SourceQuote: Provides preliminary factual information, to the extent it is known

steps.Title: S5
steps.Actor: Clinical team member (the responsible practitioner when harm is more than minor)
steps.Action: Express concern for the patient's welfare
steps.SourceQuote: Expresses concern for the patient's welfare.

steps.Title: S6
steps.Actor: Clinical team member (the responsible practitioner when harm is more than minor)
steps.Action: Reassure the patient or representative, in general terms, that steps are being taken to investigate, remedy injury, and prevent further harm
steps.SourceQuote: Reassures the patient or personal representative that steps are being taken to investigate the situation

steps.Title: S7
steps.Actor: Clinical team member (the responsible practitioner when harm is more than minor)
steps.Action: Provide contact information for the designated VA staff who will answer questions
steps.SourceQuote: must be provided with contact information of the designated VA health care staff

steps.Title: S8
steps.Action: Document the clinical disclosure in a CPRS progress note for the encounter, not the institutional disclosure template
steps.SourceQuote: documentation of a clinical disclosure is required when harm is more than minor

steps.Title: S9
steps.Action: Immediately notify the Associate Director for Patient Care Services, the Chief of Staff, or the facility Director of the significant adverse event
steps.StepInput: Significant adverse event brought to the Risk Manager's attention
steps.SourceQuote: Immediately notifying the Associate Director for Patient Care Services, Chief of Staff, or VA medical facility Director

steps.Title: S10
steps.Actor: Chief of Staff / Associate Director of Patient Care Services
steps.Action: Immediately notify the VA medical facility Director of the significant adverse event
steps.StepInput: Notification of a significant adverse event
steps.SourceQuote: Immediately notifying the VA medical facility Director regarding the discovery of any significant adverse event

steps.Title: S11
steps.Action: Communicate the adverse event that may require institutional disclosure immediately to District Chief Counsel; escalation ends here and institutional disclosure proceeds separately
steps.StepInput: Single-patient event that may require institutional disclosure
steps.SourceQuote: adverse events that may require institutional disclosure are communicated immediately to District Chief Counsel

steps.Title: S12
steps.Action: Submit an Issue Brief to the VISN Director and District Chief Counsel
steps.StepOutput: Issue Brief sent to the VISN Director and District Chief Counsel
steps.SourceQuote: Submitting an Issue Brief to the VISN Director and District Chief Counsel immediately following the discovery

steps.Title: S13
steps.Action: Submit an Issue Brief to the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.StepInput: Facility Issue Brief or other reports
steps.StepOutput: Issue Brief received at VA Central Office
steps.SourceQuote: Submitting an Issue Brief to the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management immediately

steps.Title: S14
steps.Actor: Facility leadership (facility Director, Chief of Staff, Associate Director for Patient Care Services)
steps.Action: Plan what will be communicated, by whom, and how, including the treating clinician's role if a clinical disclosure has already occurred; confer with District Chief Counsel as needed
steps.StepInput: Adverse event resulting in or expected to result in death or serious injury
steps.SourceQuote: may confer with District Chief Counsel for assistance in deciding what is to be communicated, by whom, and how

steps.Title: S15
steps.Action: Invite the patient or personal representative to meet
steps.SourceQuote: institutional leaders invite the patient or personal representative to meet

steps.Title: S16
steps.Action: Honor the request to bring an attorney and reconsider who attends on behalf of the institution
steps.StepInput: Advance request to bring an attorney
steps.SourceQuote: must be honored, but may influence the choice of participants on behalf of the institution

steps.Title: S17
steps.Action: Hold the disclosure meeting, face-to-face in a private setting where possible, and express concern, apologize, and explain the known facts
steps.SourceQuote: An expression of concern and an apology, including an explanation of the facts

steps.Title: S18
steps.Action: Outline treatment options, if appropriate
steps.SourceQuote: An outline of treatment options, if appropriate.

steps.Title: S19
steps.Action: Arrange a second opinion, additional monitoring, expedited consultations, bereavement support, or other appropriate support
steps.SourceQuote: Arrangements for a second opinion, additional monitoring, expediting clinical consultations, bereavement support

steps.Title: S20
steps.Action: Provide contact information for the designated staff who will answer questions
steps.SourceQuote: Contact information regarding designated staff who are to respond to questions

steps.Title: S21
steps.Action: Tell the patient or representative they may obtain outside medical or legal advice
steps.SourceQuote: the option of obtaining outside medical or legal advice

steps.Title: S22
steps.Action: Offer information on potential compensation and how to apply (VBA and Federal Tort Claims Act for Veterans; Federal Tort Claims Act only for non-Veterans), without assuring compensation
steps.SourceQuote: Offering information about potential compensation from the Veterans Benefits Administration and under the Federal Tort Claims Act

steps.Title: S23
steps.Actor: Risk Manager or other assigned staff member
steps.Action: Refer the patient or representative to the VACO National Torts Group for coordination of document requests
steps.StepOutput: Referral to the National Torts Group
steps.SourceQuote: must be referred to VACO National Torts Group for coordination of document requests, if a tort claim has been filed

steps.Title: S24
steps.Actor: Authorized CPRS note author (e.g., Risk Manager, Patient Safety Manager, Quality Manager, Chief of Staff)
steps.Action: Document the institutional disclosure using the CPRS Institutional Disclosure of Adverse Event note template
steps.SourceQuote: must be done using the CPRS Institutional Disclosure of Adverse Event Note Template

steps.Title: S25
steps.Action: Keep the patient or representative apprised of information that emerges from the investigation
steps.SourceQuote: the Risk Manager or organizational leaders engage the patient or personal representative to keep them apprised

steps.Title: S26
steps.Actor: Authorized CPRS note author (e.g., Risk Manager, Patient Safety Manager, Quality Manager, Chief of Staff)
steps.Action: Document each later communication about the event as an addendum to the original note
steps.StepOutput: Addendum to the Institutional Disclosure note
steps.SourceQuote: must be documented in an addendum to the original note

steps.Title: S27
steps.Actor: Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management (coordinated triage process)
steps.Action: Run the coordinated triage review with designated offices and SMEs and recommend, based on preliminary information, closing the issue, large-scale disclosure, or referral to the SME Review Panel or CRB
steps.SourceQuote: Ensuring a coordinated triage process for a review of each potential adverse event that may require large-scale disclosure

steps.Title: S28
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Concur or non-concur with the triage recommendation and provide a written record of the decision to the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.SourceQuote: Concurring or non-concurring with the recommendation of the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management's coordinated triage process

steps.Title: S29
steps.Actor: Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.Action: Refer the case to the SME Review Panel for more detailed review
steps.StepOutput: Case referred to the SME Review Panel
steps.SourceQuote: Ensuring that potential cases are referred to the SME Review Panel or CRB for more detailed review

steps.Title: S30
steps.Action: Conduct fact-finding (site visits if needed, literature reviews, risk assessments) and summarize findings on risk to patients and families
steps.SourceQuote: Conducting fact-finding, including site visits if needed, literature reviews, risk assessments

steps.Title: S31
steps.Actor: SME Review Panel (led by the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management)
steps.Action: Submit a written report to the Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health finding negligible, clinically significant, or indeterminate risk, with the matching recommendation (5.d(3) also assigns this report to the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management)
steps.SourceQuote: Submitting a written report to the Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health with one of the following three findings

steps.Title: S32
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Concur or non-concur with the SME Review Panel recommendation and provide a written record of the decision to the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.SourceQuote: providing a written record of this decision to the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management

steps.Title: S33
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Appoint the CRB Chairperson from the Deputy Under Secretary level
steps.SourceQuote: Appointing the Chairperson of the CRB from the Deputy Under Secretary-level

steps.Title: S34
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Communicate the charge to the CRB Chairperson and at the same time notify the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management, OGC, OPIA, and OCLA to begin preparing for a possible disclosure
steps.SourceQuote: communicating the charge to the CRB Chairperson and simultaneously notifying

steps.Title: S35
steps.Action: Convene and chair the CRB
steps.SourceQuote: Convening and chairing the CRB

steps.Title: S36
steps.Action: Review the SME Review Panel's information and risk assessment, seeking clarifications as needed
steps.SourceQuote: Reviewing the information and risk assessment provided by the SME Review Panel, seeking clarifications as necessary.

steps.Title: S37
steps.Action: Weigh the clinical, scientific, epidemiologic, and non-clinical factors and vote on whether to recommend disclosure and whether an epidemiologic investigation is recommended
steps.SourceQuote: to determine whether a recommendation for disclosure of the adverse event to patients and families is appropriate

steps.Title: S38
steps.Action: Provide the Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health with a plan and timeline for a definitive CRB recommendation
steps.StepInput: CRB conclusion that information is insufficient
steps.SourceQuote: providing the Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health with a plan and timeline for a definitive CRB recommendation

steps.Title: S39
steps.Action: Provide written recommendations and justifications on behalf of the CRB, addressing patient notification, facility follow-up, and inquiry at other facilities when disclosure is recommended
steps.SourceQuote: written recommendations and justifications to the Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health

steps.Title: S40
steps.Action: Provide a written statement on whether the recommendation was unanimous and, if not, the assenting and dissenting votes and their rationales
steps.SourceQuote: whether the CRB recommendation regarding disclosure was unanimous

steps.Title: S41
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Request further information or guidance from the CRB
steps.SourceQuote: Requesting further information or guidance from the CRB, as needed, prior to making a final decision.

steps.Title: S42
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Concur or non-concur with the CRB recommendations and communicate the decision to the Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management and the CRB Chairperson
steps.SourceQuote: Concurring or non-concurring with the CRB recommendations, and communicating that decision

steps.Title: S43
steps.Actor: Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.Action: Notify field sites of the large-scale disclosure, coordinating with OGC, OPIA, OCLA, and other offices
steps.StepInput: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health decision to disclose
steps.SourceQuote: Implementation includes notification of field sites

steps.Title: S44
steps.Actor: Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.Action: Activate a site visit team
steps.SourceQuote: activation of a site visit team

steps.Title: S45
steps.Actor: Office of the General Counsel and other appropriate offices
steps.Action: Review the written materials and statements for the disclosure
steps.SourceQuote: a review of written materials and statements by OGC, and other appropriate offices

steps.Title: S46
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Assign responsibility for leading, organizing, and conducting the look-back program and epidemiologic investigation
steps.StepInput: Need for a look-back or investigation
steps.SourceQuote: Assigning responsibility for leading, organizing, and conducting any required VHA look-back program and epidemiologic investigation

steps.Title: S47
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (or designee)
steps.Action: Ensure facility and VISN leadership are notified that an epidemiologic investigation will take place, and set a clear line of authority, access, and accountability
steps.SourceQuote: Ensuring that VA medical facility and VISN leadership is notified that an epidemiologic investigation is going to take place

steps.Title: S48
steps.Actor: Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.Action: Designate and facilitate the look-back activities and epidemiologic investigation
steps.SourceQuote: Designating and facilitating any required look-back activities and epidemiologic investigations

steps.Title: S49
steps.Actor: VA medical facility Director (or designee), coordinated by VHA officials
steps.Action: Notify the potentially affected patients or their personal representatives
steps.SourceQuote: coordinating the notification to multiple patients (or their personal representatives)

steps.Title: S50
steps.Actor: Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.Action: Coordinate with VA medical facilities to ensure required clinical follow-up is provided to potentially affected patients
steps.SourceQuote: Coordination with VA medical facilities to ensure that required clinical follow-up is provided for potentially-affected patients.

steps.Title: S51
steps.Actor: Principal Deputy Under Secretary for Health (VA Central Office)
steps.Action: Notify VBA Central Office that Veterans' benefits may be affected
steps.SourceQuote: Notification by VA Central Office to the Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA) Central Office component

steps.Title: S52
steps.Actor: Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Operations and Management
steps.Action: Conduct an After Action Review with SME participation and submit a report to the Under Secretary for Health
steps.SourceQuote: Conducting an After Action Review of the event with appropriate SME participation and submitting a report to the Under Secretary for Health

steps.Title: S53
steps.Action: Collect, track, and analyze information on the facility's institutional disclosures for the quarterly report
steps.StepInput: Institutional disclosures conducted at the facility
steps.SourceQuote: Establishing a process for collection, tracking, and analysis of relevant information related to institutional disclosures

steps.Title: S54
steps.Action: Report the number and types of the facility's institutional disclosures to the VISN Director
steps.SourceQuote: Providing a report quarterly, and as requested, to the VISN Director

steps.Title: S55
steps.Action: Report the VISN's institutional disclosures (event date, disclosure date, number of unique patients, any death, departments involved, triggering event) to the Assistant Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Quality, Safety, and Value
steps.SourceQuote: Providing a report quarterly, and as requested, to the Assistant Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Quality, Safety, and Value

steps.Title: S56
steps.Actor: Assistant Deputy Under Secretary for Health for Quality, Safety, and Value (or designee)
steps.Action: Complete a quarterly review and analysis of the institutional disclosures reported by each VISN
